summary: Pierson–Moskowitz law: wave height scales with wind speed squared in a fully-developed sea. The relationship breaks down for short fetches or rapidly changing wind fields.

ranges.phrase: Fitted coefficient is small — the wind-wave coupling is weaker than canonical PM, suggesting limited fetch or transient wind.
Coefficient sits near the canonical PM range; fully-developed-sea assumption holds.
Coefficient is unusually high — possible amplification mechanism or instrument calibration issue.
